title: Project Planning, Milestones and Work Breakdown
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and value of Project Planning, Milestones and Work Breakdown.
Apply project planning, milestones and work breakdown to a Python project scenario.
Identify decisions and trade-offs relevant to project planning, milestones and work breakdown.
Review common mistakes and risks in project planning, milestones and work breakdown.
Produce a verifiable project artifact using project planning, milestones and work breakdown principles.

understand.concept: A project plan turns an outcome into deliverable work, dependencies, owners and checkpoints. A work breakdown decomposes a large goal into manageable tasks. Milestones mark meaningful evidence of progress rather than merely elapsed time.
understand.whyItMatters: Planning reveals dependencies and risks early, making a capstone easier to deliver in controlled increments.
understand.analogy: A long journey is divided into stages with clear destinations and check-ins.
understand.analogyLimit: Plans are estimates, not guarantees; new information can require re-planning.
understand.summary: Project Planning, Milestones and Work Breakdown helps learners deliver and maintain reliable Python projects.

explain.narrative: Break the project into deliverables, then smaller tasks with clear completion evidence. Identify dependencies, risk, effort and ownership. Set milestones around working outcomes such as a tested data model or a usable workflow. Review progress and adjust scope when estimates change.
